2607.25600.title: Beyond Self-Knowledge: Propagating Uncertainty Across Reasoning and Retrieval in LLMs
2607.25600.paper_summary: Retrieval-augmented generation improves knowledge-intensive question answering, but indiscriminate retrieval can introduce irrelevant evidence and unnecessary computation. We investigate whether verbalized confidence from black-box language models can serve as an actionable signal for retrieval routing. Our method, BeyondUncertainty, first elicits a structured provisional answer and confidence estimate, then applies a model-specific threshold selected on held-out validation data and frozen before test evaluation. Low-confidence questions receive top-$5$ TF--IDF retrieval followed by a second answer call, whereas high-confidence questions return the provisional answer directly. We evaluate 27,000 policy instances across six QA benchmarks, three model families, and three retrieval policies. BeyondUncertainty achieves $0.483$ mean token-level F1, compared with $0.467$ for always retrieval and $0.401$ for no retrieval, while reducing retrieved passages by $20.4\%$ relative to always retrieval. When matched on the number of questions routed to retrieval within each dataset--model cell, it outperforms a post-hoc random allocation in 17 of 18 settings, with an average gain of 0.024 F1. Although poorly calibrated as an absolute probability, probe uncertainty modestly predicts question-level retrieval benefit (AUROC $=0.628$). However, the additional probe increases total token usage by $28.2\%$, revealing a trade-off between more selective evidence acquisition and end-to-end token efficiency.
2607.25600.paper_summary_zh: 檢索增強生成改善了知識密集型問題回答，但不加區別的檢索可能引入不相關的證據和不必要的計算。我們調查了黑箱語言模型中口頭表達的信心是否可以作為檢索路由的可行信號。我們的方法，BeyondUncertainty，首先引出一個結構化的臨時答案和信心估計，然後應用在保留的驗證數據上選擇的模型特定閾值，並在測試評估之前保持不變。低信心問題接收前五名的 TF--IDF 檢索，然後進行第二次答案調用，而高信心問題則直接返回臨時答案。我們在六個 QA 基準、三個模型系列和三個檢索策略中評估了 27,000 個策略實例。BeyondUncertainty 的平均標記級 F1 為 0.483，而始終檢索為 0.467，無檢索為 0.401，同時相對於始終檢索減少了 20.4% 的檢索段落。當在每個數據集-模型單元中匹配路由到檢索的問題數量時，它在 18 個設置中的 17 個中超越了事後隨機分配，平均增益為 0.024 F1。儘管作為絕對概率的校準不佳，但探測不確定性適度預測了問題級檢索的好處（AUROC = 0.628）。然而，額外的探測使總標記使用量增加了 28.2%，顯示出在更具選擇性的證據獲取和端到端標記效率之間的權衡。
